ai.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
ai.brief: NVIDIA and Microsoft are extending their full-stack collaboration to help organizations build, customize and deploy intelligent applications — from next-generation infrastructure on Azure to industrial systems and Windows PCs. At Microsoft Ignite , the companies are expanding access to Azure virtual machines powered by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, as well as adding customer availability to NVIDIA open models and customization capabilities through Microsoft Foundry, and new options for running AI at the edge, where businesses generate and use their data. Microsoft is also using NVIDIA technologies to accelerate its own models and services, including NVIDIA Dynamo inference software for post-training and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs for Bing search models. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems are running in Azure data centers , providing infrastructure designed for demanding reasoning, agentic applications, and large-scale model training and inference.

sec.title: Chaotic Eclipse Releases FastUnlock, a New Windows Zero-Day Vulnerability
sec.brief: S. CISA adds Apache Axis, Vanderbilt REDCap,BerriAI LiteLLM, and Synology DSM flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Norwegian Gas Giant Equinor Says It's Under Cyberattack. S. S. Banks Struggle With Outages Amid Wider Technology Disruptions Security researcher Chaotic Eclipse , also known as INFINITE NIGHTMARE, MSNightmare and Nightmare-Eclipse, released a new Windows zero-day vulnerability, dubbed FastUnlock, exploiting Narrator to bypass the lock screen. According to the researcher, exploiting it can bypass BitLocker encryption and allow code execution under the lock screen’s WsiAccount. He claims he breached a fully encrypted Windows 11 26H2 system in just five minutes, even with the November security updates installed.
